subject: Win the Mall
query: what is win the mall on netflix
title: What is Win the Mall on Netflix? The shopping competition, explained
answer: Win the Mall is a Netflix reality competition premiering Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. Ten teams of expert shoppers compete inside a real, working shopping mall to take control of storefronts, grow their spending power and outmaneuver rivals. Content creator Haley Baylee hosts, and Fremantle produces the series.
body:
Netflix calls the show "the ultimate fantasy retail experience" that turns "a classic American shopping mall into a thrilling game of strategy and unexpected twists." The official logline describes it as "part shopping spree, part social strategy." Only one contestant is crowned the winner and walks away with what the producers call "the keys to the ultimate prize"; Netflix has not said what the prize is or which mall was used.

Special guests Jonathan Van Ness, Keith Lee, Salish Matter and Lilly Singh join Baylee for mall-themed challenges. Baylee, whose name is sometimes misspelled "Haylee Baylee," is a former scientist who became a full-time creator, host and model; she won Sports Illustrated's Model Search in 2017. Netflix announced the series on March 17, 2026. Jimmy Fox executive produces for Fremantle, with Charles Wachter as showrunner.
in_the_news: Netflix's new shopping competition Win the Mall premieres Nov. 18, 2026, just ahead of the Black Friday shopping season.
